move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

It sounds like firm commitments, rather than forecasts alone, are what let you allocate scarce capacity. We are ready to commit long-term in return for secure coverage of our full requirement, giving you dependable demand for capacity planning. How can we turn that commitment into a firm allocation?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
Please note:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
The proposed volume of 23,400 units over a 36-month term provides the necessary foundation for firm capacity allocation.
Your should-cost estimate does not accurately reflect the realities of our specialized production.
We accept your proposed terms at a unit price of EUR 31.50.
Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Which volume can you commit to?
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You identify long-term commitment as the foundation for firm allocation and ask for volume confirmation—it sounds like dependable demand is what enables you to reserve capacity. We are ready to make that commitment so you can plan production confidently and we can secure our full requirement. How can we translate that planning certainty into firm allocation and a price that reflects the value of our commitment?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.11 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €31.20 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For the record:
We have verified the labour cost index data you provided; it holds and we took it into account.
Your firm commitment to 23,400 units over 36 months provides the required planning certainty.
We therefore adjust our offer to EUR 31.20 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Which volume can you commit to?
These are our standard conditions for this product.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
